name: arc-flow-carousel
title: Arc Flow Carousel
description: Draggable image carousel where cards ride a wheel arc, with flick momentum, idle drift, and reduced-motion support.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How fast the fan catches up to the pointer. Higher feels snappier.

props.name: dragSensitivity
props.description: How far the fan travels per pixel dragged or scrolled.

props.name: autoRotateSpeed
props.description: Constant idle drift in rad/s. Positive drifts new cards in from the left.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pauses the idle drift while a pointer hovers the carousel.

props.name: snap
props.description: Snaps to the nearest card once a flick or wheel input settles.

props.name: radiusRatio
props.description: Circle radius as a multiple of the container width. Bigger is a flatter arc.

props.name: cardRatio
props.description: Card width as a fraction of the container width, clamped by min/max card width.

props.name: maxCardWidth
props.description: Upper bound on card width, in pixels.

props.name: overlap
props.description: 0 = cards touch edge to edge, 0.3 = overlap by 30%, negative = a gap between them.

props.name: arcOffset
props.description: Vertical position of the leading card's centre, as a fraction of height.

props.name: surfaceColor
props.description: Shared hex color for the carousel background and wheel surface.
